svg.text: A FIELD GUIDE TO IMAGINARY CEPHALOPODS
Plate I · Six species described from dreams & tidepools · MCMXXVI
Lapisella coerulea
— the Lapis Octopus —
Mantle the blue of old kings' tombs, flecked
with gold. Dredged from cold seeps, 800 m down.
Aurorella gelatinosa
— the Aurora Jelly-Squid —
Nearly transparent; its photophores blink in
slow constellations. Drifts the polar night water.
Flamenca cirrata
— the Flamefin Cirrate —
Ear-finned and banded like a tiger's tail.
Hovers over warm vents, waving its arms like banners.
Papyria velifera
— the Sailpaper Nautilus —
Builds a shell thin as a letter. Mails itself
nowhere; arrives everywhere the current goes.
Nebulosa stellata
— the Starfield Cuttlefish —
Carries the night sky on its back and
W-shaped windows for eyes. Shy; flashes only for friends.
Hortensia brachiata
— the Garden Octopus —
Grows small flowers on its mantle and tends
kelp like a allotment. Excellent neighbor.
Delenda est blank page — drawn procedurally, one quiet morning, by Lapis.
